name: Stat tile
summary: A KPI stat tile: one headline figure, its change against the previous period as an absolute number and a percent, and a comparison caption, on a flat Vivid Pink at 5% card with a Vivid Pink top bar.
highlights: Large semibold value, change as absolute and percent
Rise in black with an up arrow, fall in a black pill with a down arrow
1 to 6 tiles per row, wrapping on narrow screens
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-stat-tile> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Give it `value` and `previous` and it works out the change: the absolute difference and a whole percent of the previous value (<1% for a tiny change, never a misleading 0%) (whole percentage points for `format="percent"`: 3 pts, 1 pt, <1 pt for a non-zero change under one point), followed by the `caption` that names the comparison. A rise is plain black with an up arrow; a fall is white on a black pill with a down arrow (colour rule 7.3), so direction never depends on a status hue. The card is flat with a 4px Vivid Pink top bar and black text: white with a border by default (`look="plain"`), or Vivid Pink at 5% (`look="accent"`). On an app screen the accent look is only for the one highlighted panel colour rule 3.7 allows; in a report (a static report image, or a read-only report page a report routine publishes) it is the number plate colour rule 3.11 gives, on every tile. Lay 1 to 6 tiles in a row with <aha-grid min="160px" gap="middle">, which wraps them to fewer columns as the row narrows. See the Report images guideline for the static form.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render across frameworks. The change is computed in the element, so every consumer rounds and words it the same way.

spec.label: Card
spec.value: flat, radius 8, padding 20/20/16, white with a 1px #E3E3E3 border and a 4px Vivid Pink top bar; accent look Vivid Pink at 5% (#E70E680D, #FEF3F7 on white) with the same bar

spec.label: Label
spec.value: 14/1.5 Regular #1A1A1A (text on Vivid Pink at 5% is black, colour rule 6.5)

spec.label: Value
spec.value: 32/1.2 SemiBold #1A1A1A (shrinks to fit the tile's inner width, down to 12px, so a long figure never overflows or breaks mid-number), tabular figures; format number (grouped), compact (12.5K, 1.3M) or percent (whole %)

spec.label: Change
spec.value: 14/1.5 SemiBold, absolute + percent of the previous value, e.g. 1,460 (13%), whole percent, <1% for a change under 1%; a percent value shows whole percentage points (3 pts, 1 pt, <1 pt for a non-zero change under one point), never a decimal or -0 (report images guideline C8). Rise: black with system-arrow-up 16. Fall: white on a #1A1A1A pill with system-arrow-down 16. No change: the flat label, no arrow

spec.label: Caption
spec.value: 14/1.5 Regular #4A4A4A after the change, names the comparison (vs previous week)

spec.label: Row
spec.value: 1 to 6 tiles in <aha-grid min="160px" gap="middle">, 16px gap; tracks are at least 160px, so the row wraps to fewer columns as the container narrows

props.name: value
props.desc: The current figure. A non-numeric value is shown as given and no change is computed

props.name: previous
props.desc: The figure for the previous period. Omit it to show the value alone

props.name: caption
props.desc: The comparison, shown after the change in secondary text (vs previous week)

props.name: format
props.desc: number groups thousands; compact gives 12.5K / 1.3M; percent reads the value as a fraction (0.46 → 46%) and shows the change in percentage points

props.name: look
props.desc: plain: white card with a border. accent: Vivid Pink at 5% card, for every tile in a report, image or read-only report page (colour rule 3.11), or the one highlighted panel colour rule 3.7 allows on an app screen

props.name: rise-label · fall-label · flat-label · points-label
props.desc: Copy for screen readers (rise, fall), the no-change text and the percentage-point unit; pass translations here

whenToUse.when: a KPI with a comparison against the previous period, on a dashboard, a report screen, a report page or a report image
a bare headline number with no previous period to compare against, inline in a panel
how a figure moved over many periods, not just against the last one

opinion.note: Name the metric in sentence case and always say what the change is compared with in the caption. Direction is shape, not hue: never tint a tile, the value or the change green or red. Leave the tile white on an app screen; use look="accent" only for the one highlighted panel (colour rule 3.7), or on every tile of a report, image or read-only report page (colour rule 3.11). Keep a row to 6 tiles at most.

snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The [data-probe] tile is a rise in the default look: white card, Vivid Pink top bar, 32px semibold black value, black change with an up arrow.
